[Zeroth-loop variation identity] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0056 1. ch17:17.31\group Variation Formulas

If $\beta ^{(0)}=g$, $\gamma ^{(0)}=n/2$, and $\mathcal F_0=-\int f e^{-f}d\mu $, then \[ \delta _{(\beta ^{(0)},\gamma ^{(0)})}\mathcal F_1 +\delta _{(\beta ^{(1)},\gamma ^{(1)})}\mathcal F_0=0. \]
